propositions: Tool-call loops in the completion gate verify step exhaust the step budget, surface bare LLMError with null diagnostic, and leave no actionable exit except --force-close
The tool_step_limit empty-filter rewrite in agent_call.py causes Bedrock/Anthropic 400 errors due to toolConfig undefined when history contains toolUse blocks
Budget exhaustion in CompletionAgentStep.run catches only UnretryableOutputError, preventing recovery and verdict construction from fresh per-criterion evidence
The existing repetition metric (adjacent k-cycle detection) is inverted on real traces and fails to distinguish pathological loops from healthy high-breadth runs
Runaway detection must occur during the run (before budget exhaustion) and route to bounded recovery with tool-free finalizer to build verdict from unspoiled history
Gate runs lack durable usage recording (request count, tool calls, distinct ratio, consecutive repeats) needed to tune and validate the loop-detector threshold
